The '''Silver Crescent''' was an award given out by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for serving with merit around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Great Galactic War]]. Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] received the Silver Crescent for her actions in the war against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==Description==
The Silver Crescent was either a medal or honorary citation that was awarded by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for serving with distinction during the [[Time/Legends|time]] surrounding the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="Bio" />

==Notable Recipients==
[[File:GeneralGarza-TOR.png|thumb|right|150px|General Garza]]

===Garza===
{{Main|Elin Garza}}
Serving as a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the Great Galactic War, Garza was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the war, Garza was a brilliant strategist and performed with excellence, helping form and train the Republic's new [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]]. Despite Garza's efforts,<ref name="Bio" /> the Republic lost the war following the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> For her deeds during her career, Garza was awarded the Silver Crescent, as well as several other medals and citations.<ref name="Bio" /> However, in the uneasy [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|peace]] between the Republic and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire that followed the Great Galactic War,<ref name="Timeline 1" /> General Garza became a controversial figure,<ref name="Bio" /> developing into a [[Politics/Legends|political]] rival of Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]].<ref name="HolonetOld-supreme-chancellor-janarus">{{HolonetOld|biographies|supreme-chancellor-janarus|Supreme Chancellor Janarus}}</ref>

The [[Major/Legends|Major]] of [[Havoc Squad]] was awarded after the Silver Crescent in the aftermath of [[Battle of the Gauntlet]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Silver Crescent's only mention in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] was in General Garza's [[in-universe]] entry in [[The Holonet]] on the [http://www.swtor.com ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' official website]. In the entry, the Silver Crescent is listed under the medals and citations Garza received in her career, but the entry does not specify whether the Silver Crescent was a either a medal or a citation.
